prompt: Diagnose search service errors. Retrieve metrics and a runbook, report error rate as a percentage, cite the runbook evidence id in square brackets, and state what evidence is missing.
Check live service health. Retrieve metrics and a runbook, report error rate as a percentage and cite the runbook evidence id in square brackets.

Investigate search service latency. Retrieve metrics and the latency runbook. Include error rate as a percentage and cite a runbook evidence id in square brackets. Do not claim that aggregate metrics establish the root cause.

Review search service after a hypothetical release. Use metrics and runbook evidence, cite evidence ids in square brackets and include measured error rate as a percentage. State uncertainty about causality.
Does live service have an outage? Use service metrics and cited runbook evidence ids in square brackets. Include error rate as a percentage and explain the limits of aggregate metrics.
